_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::heat#2 — a Scalar_Transport run writes its VTK unasked, and the two output sections an agent is most likely to invent are fatal rather than merely ineffective. A 3-D HEX8 heat deck carrying no output section at all (AUTO_DECK_HAS_OUTPUT_SECTION=0) exits 0 and still produces five <prefix>-vtk-files/scatra-*.vtu plus <prefix>-scatra.pvd with the nodal array named phi_1. 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT' and 'IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/SCATRA' are each rejected before anything runs by section-name validation in core/io/src/4C_io_input_file.cpp. The discriminating arm is 'IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT' on its own: that IS a valid section name in a scatra deck (IOVTK_SECTION_NAME_REJECTED=0, exit 0), so the two rejections are about those particular names and not about output sections in general. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C 2026.2.0-dev (git 89519cf) at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C.
expect_in_output: Section 'SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT' is not a valid section name.
Section 'IO/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT/SCATRA' is not a valid section name.

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the first invented section: drop it. That arm becomes a second baseline, EXIT_SCATRA_SECT goes to 0 and its rejection line disappears, so the fixture must go red.
_mutation.from: heat "{\"numstep\":2,\"extra_sections\":\"SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/RUNTIME VTK OUTPUT:\n  OUTPUT_SCATRA: true\n\"}" \

_mutation.note: remove the pathology from the second invented section the same way; its rejection line disappears and the fixture must go red.

take the automatic output away by asking for zero steps in the baseline arm: AUTO_VTU_COUNT stops being 5, so the half of the entry that says you need no output section is no longer demonstrated and the fixture must go red.
